tools.name: leadsquared_quick_search_leads
tools.description: Find leads whose first name, last name, email, phone, mobile, company, city or country contains a text. Same as the Quick Search box in LeadSquared. GET LeadManagement.svc/Leads.GetByQuickSearch.

tools.name: leadsquared_get_lead
tools.description: Return one lead's details (name, email, phone, owner, custom fields) by ProspectID. Returns an empty list when the id does not exist. GET LeadManagement.svc/Leads.GetById.

tools.name: leadsquared_search_leads
tools.description: Find leads where one lead field matches a value, for example CreatedOn after a date, or EmailAddress equal to an address. Pass the field's schema name (LookupName) and the operator (SqlOperator, for example = or > or LIKE). POST LeadManagement.svc/Leads.Get.

tools.name: leadsquared_get_lead_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks (follow-ups, calls, to-dos) created against one lead. GET LeadManagement.svc/RetrieveTaskByLeadId.

tools.name: leadsquared_get_lead_activities
tools.description: List the activities (calls, emails, notes, custom activities) of one lead, newest data included. Pass an activity_event code to keep one type only. POST ProspectActivity.svc/Retrieve.

tools.name: leadsquared_get_lead_opportunities
tools.description: List the opportunities linked to one lead, with their fields. Pass opportunity_type to keep one opportunity type only. POST OpportunityManagement.svc/GetOpportunitiesOfLead.

tools.name: leadsquared_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the LeadSquared account (name, email, role, active status). Use it to find an owner's user id. GET UserManagement.svc/Users.Get.

tools.name: leadsquared_create_or_update_lead
tools.description: Create a lead, or update the lead that already has this email address or phone number. Pass the fields as name and value pairs using schema names, for example FirstName, LastName, EmailAddress, Phone, Company. POST LeadManagement.svc/Lead.CreateOrUpdate.

tools.name: leadsquared_post_lead_activity
tools.description: Add an activity (for example a note or a custom activity) to one lead. Each call adds a new activity: it is not idempotent. POST ProspectActivity.svc/Create.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: leadsquared_quick_search_leads, leadsquared_get_lead, leadsquared_search_leads, leadsquared_get_lead_activities, leadsquared_get_lead_opportunities, leadsquared_list_users · Public sink: leadsquared_quick_search_leads, leadsquared_get_lead, leadsquared_search_leads, leadsquared_get_lead_activities, leadsquared_get_lead_opportunities, leadsquared_list_users, leadsquared_create_or_update_lead, leadsquared_post_lead_activity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: leadsquared_quick_search_leads, leadsquared_get_lead, leadsquared_search_leads, leadsquared_get_lead_activities, leadsquared_get_lead_opportunities, leadsquared_list_users · Public sink: leadsquared_quick_search_leads, leadsquared_get_lead, leadsquared_search_leads, leadsquared_get_lead_activities, leadsquared_get_lead_opportunities, leadsquared_list_users, leadsquared_create_or_update_lead, leadsquared_post_lead_activity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
